title: HISLIP: Add HiSLIP 2.0 protocol support
description:
### Description

Updates the HiSLIP dissector to fully support the **IVI-6.1 HiSLIP 2.0 specification**, introducing secure connection handling (TLS), authentication mechanisms (SASL), and enhanced control code parsing.

#### Key Enhancements

* **Protocol Extensions & Error Handling:** Adds new HiSLIP 2.0 message types covering TLS, SASL, and Descriptors, adjusts reserved ranges, and registers version 2.0 fatal/non-fatal error types.
* **Bitmask & Control Code Decoding:** Implements sub-field bitmask parsing for `InitializeResponse`, `AsyncInitializeResponse`, and device clear control codes (`DeviceClearAcknowledge`, `DeviceClearComplete`, `AsyncDeviceClearAcknowledge`).
* **Dynamic TLS/Plaintext Switching:** Integrates a state tree (`tls_transitions`) to route encrypted payloads to Wireshark's core TLS dissector upon `StartTLS` sequences, with support for tracking plaintext transitions via `AsyncEndTLS` and `close_notify` alerts.
* **Field Registration & Infrastructure:** Registers new header fields (`hf_*`) and subtree indices (`ett_*`) to map 32-bit MessageIDs, synchronization markers, and formatting properties safely.

Signed-off-by: Ivan Anzarski ivann2sg@gmail.com \
Co-authored-by: Guido Kiener guido.kiener@rohde-schwarz.com \
AI-Assisted: Claude
